name: standing pose (form check: incorrect, side view)
description: A side-view standing posture example marked as incorrect. Use it to check head, rib cage and pelvis alignment.
instructions: Stand sideways to a mirror with your feet about hip-width apart and knees relaxed.
Check that your ears, shoulders and hips are roughly stacked, without forcing a perfectly straight back.
Keep your ribs over your pelvis and avoid copying the posture marked with a red cross.
Let your arms hang naturally and breathe normally.
